items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You sing a sign, haven't you, Ralph?

ctx.x: You sing a sign, haven't you, Ralph? Yeah, but I've usually heard it pronounced San Suu. I thought it was French.

I was going to ask you, when you were a boy, did you learn French? Did you mention your grandmother spoke French? She did. I could talk a little, not much. My grandmother was strictly French. I thought maybe the whole family spoke French when you were a boy. Well, yeah, most of the whole family would talk. Yeah, but I, I mean, I could talk it pretty good. I could understand it pretty good. But I never kept it a... You went to a regular public school. Oh, yeah. I wondered, was your family Catholic? Catholic. They…
